positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
Online CalWorks Appraisal Tool

Enterprise application for California case workers in 58 counties ' welfare departments to appraise clients in the CalWORKs program. The system uses business rules to create recommendations and appraisals based on responses from a detailed questionnaire.

-Implemented role based access throughout enterprise application.
-Played a role in a complete front end redesign to improve application performance and increase
development productivity by:
* Memoizing React components and functions.
* Streamlining API requests.
* Improving application state structure.
- Took on challenge of solutioning custom data entry tables with complex, interconnected form state.
- Restructured and redesigned the backend.
- Responsible for designing and implementing several core application features.
- Key role in generating automated unit tests for the front end of the application. Personally contributed 40% of coverage to the front end using Jest and Enzyme.

Big Annual Meeting Web App (BAM App)

Web application for Cambria's BAM 2-day conference. Provided attendees with a schedule of sessions for
each day of the event, a social media feed to users to post announcements, an interactive scavenger hunt game with a live leaderboard tracking progress, and maps to and of the event.
- Led the effort in producing the application.
- Used Jira for workflow management. Tracked project through sprints and created, assigned, and
completed bugs, tasks, stories, and epics.

MDHS Chatbot

Chatbot for the state of Mississippi's Child Support Service. Leveraging Google's machine learning and
natural language processing platform, Dialogow, the MDHS chatbot is a self learning chatbot that
allows citizens from the state of Mississippi receive instant responses to questions, schedule appointments, calculate payments, and more.

- Carried out content changes for MDHS Chatbot.
- Implemented "Back" feature to allow users to rewind thorough their conversation with the chatbot.
